cases.testName: project Goal list exposes live snapshots across sessions without mutating either Goal
cases.expected: The project index shows both session-local live Goal snapshots, marks the current session, and leaves both exact persisted states unchanged.

cases.testName: project Goal list can inspect another session by Goal id prefix without adopting it
cases.expected: A session with no Goal can inspect a foreign live Goal by id prefix without creating, adopting, pausing, or rewriting any Goal state.
